# VO 0.2.3
- Updates now install themselves. VO is never quit, so a downloaded update used to wait for a relaunch that never came. It now relaunches into the new version once you have been away from the keyboard for two minutes and nothing is recording. The VO menu also gets an "Install VO x.y.z and Relaunch" item while an update is waiting. - One last manual step: this mechanism arrives with 0.2.3, so if an older VO is running, quit it once (or install this disk image) to get there. From then on it looks after itself.

# VO 0.2.2
- Dictation now works while Settings is open. The microphone level meter in Settings steps aside for dictation, voice commands and meetings, says that it is paused, and comes back on its own. - Includes the 0.2.1 changes: Check for Updates in the VO menu, and the time-saved readout in days, weeks and months.

# VO 0.2.1
- Check for Updates is now in the normal VO menu at the top left of the screen, as well as the microphone menu on the right. - Includes the latest dictation, Australian English, meeting notes, speaker naming, audio review, voice coaching and Nighthawk appearance updates. - The voice output chart shows the exact date and word count when you hover over a day.
If the app still has the green appearance, open Settings → Appearance → Nighthawk for the newer look.
